title: त्रिनवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 193 · Uttanka appeals to King Brihadashva

summary.en: Markandeya traces the line of Ikshvaku to King Brihadashva, who wished to retire to the forest. Uttanka begs him first to slay Dhundhu, a mighty demon lying beneath the sands near his hermitage whose breathing shakes the earth and disturbs his austerities.
summary.kn: ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ಇಕ್ಷ್ವಾಕುವಂಶವನ್ನು ವನವಾಸ ಬಯಸಿದ ಬೃಹದಶ್ವರಾಜನವರೆಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ತನ್ನ ಆಶ್ರಮದ ಬಳಿ ಮರಳಿನಡಿ ಮಲಗಿ ಉಸಿರಾಟದಿಂದ ಭೂಮಿ ನಡುಗಿಸಿ ತಪಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಭಂಗ ತರುವ ಮಹಾದಾನವ ಧುಂಧುವನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ಕೊಲ್ಲೆಂದು ಉತ್ತಂಕನು ಅವನನ್ನು ಬೇಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: मार्कण्डेय इक्ष्वाकु के वंश का वर्णन राजा बृहदश्व तक करते हैं, जो वन जाना चाहते थे। उत्तङ्क उनसे विनती करते हैं कि पहले धुन्धु का वध करें, जो उनके आश्रम के पास बालू के नीचे लेटा महादैत्य है और जिसकी साँस से पृथ्वी काँपती है और उनका तप भंग होता है।
summary.te: మార్కండేయుడు ఇక్ష్వాకు వంశాన్ని వనవాసం కోరిన బృహదశ్వరాజు వరకు వివరిస్తాడు. తన ఆశ్రమం దగ్గర ఇసుక కింద పడుకొని శ్వాసతో భూమిని కంపింపజేస్తూ తపస్సుకు భంగం కలిగించే మహాదానవుడు ధుంధును ముందుగా సంహరించమని ఉత్తంకుడు అతనిని వేడుకుంటాడు.
summary.ta: மார்க்கண்டேயர் இக்ஷ்வாகு குலத்தைக் காடு செல்ல விரும்பிய ப்ருஹதஶ்வ மன்னன் வரை விவரிக்கிறார். தம் ஆசிரமத்தருகே மணலுக்கடியில் கிடந்து மூச்சால் பூமியை நடுங்கச் செய்து தவத்தைக் கெடுக்கும் பேரசுரன் துந்துவை முதலில் கொல்லுமாறு உத்தங்கர் அவனை வேண்டுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ഇക്ഷ്വാകുവംശം മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ ബൃഹദശ്വരാജാവിലേക്ക് പറഞ്ഞെത്തുന്നു; വനത്തിലേക്ക് വിരമിക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ച അദ്ദേഹത്തോട് ഉതങ്കൻ അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു: ആശ്രമത്തിനടുത്ത് മണലിനടിയിൽ കിടക്കുന്ന, ശ്വാസത്താൽ ഭൂമി കുലുക്കുകയും തപസ്സ് തടസ്സപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു മഹാസുരനായ ധുന്ധുവിനെ ആദ്യം വധിക്കണം.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.193; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
इक्ष्वाकौ संस्थिते राजञ्शशादः पृथिवीमिमाम् ।
प्राप्तः परमधर्मात्मा सोऽयोध्यायां नृपोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: When Ikshvaku had died, king, Shashada, supremely righteous, came into possession of this earth and became the king at Ayodhya.

verses.text:
शशादस्य तु दायादः ककुत्स्थो नाम वीर्यवान् ।
अनेनाश्चापि काकुत्स्थः पृथुश्चानेनसः सुतः ॥

meaning.en: Shashada's heir was the mighty Kakutstha; Anenas was his son, and Prithu was the son of Anenas.

verses.text:
विष्वगश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस्तस्मादार्द्रस्तु जज्ञिवान् ।
आर्द्रस्य युवनाश्वस्तु श्रावस्तस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥

meaning.en: Prithu's son was Vishvagashva, and from him Ardra was born; Ardra's son was Yuvanashva, and his son was Shravasta.

verses.text:
जज्ञे श्रावस्तको राजा श्रावस्ती येन निर्मिता ।
श्रावस्तस्य तु दायादो बृहदश्वो महाबलः ।
बृहदश्वसुतश्चापि कुवलाश्व इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Shravastaka was born as king, by whom Shravasti was built. Shravasta's heir was the very mighty Brihadashva, and Brihadashva's son was called Kuvalashva.

verses.text:
कुवलाश्वस्य पुत्राणां सहस्राण्येकविंशतिः ।
सर्वे विद्यासु निष्णाता बलवन्तो दुरासदाः ॥

meaning.en: Kuvalashva had twenty-one thousand sons, all learned in the sciences, strong and hard to withstand.

verses.text:
कुवलाश्वस्तु पितृतो गुणैरभ्यधिकोऽभवत् ।
समये तं ततो राज्ये बृहदश्वोऽभ्यषेचयत् ।
कुवलाश्वं महाराज शूरमुत्तमधार्मिकम् ॥

meaning.en: Kuvalashva surpassed his father in virtues, so in due time Brihadashva consecrated Kuvalashva, brave and most righteous, as king, great king.

verses.text:
पुत्रसंक्रामितश्रीस्तु बृहदश्वो महीपतिः ।
जगाम तपसे धीमांस्तपोवनममित्रहा ॥

meaning.en: Having passed his royal fortune to his son, the wise king Brihadashva, slayer of foes, went to a forest of austerity.

verses.text:
अथ शुश्राव राजर्षिं तमुत्तङ्को युधिष्ठिर ।
वनं संप्रस्थितं राजन्बृहदश्वं द्विजोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Then Uttanka, Yudhishthira, the best of brahmins, heard that the royal sage Brihadashva was setting out for the forest.

verses.text:
तमुत्तङ्को महातेजाः सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरम् ।
न्यवारयदमेयात्मा समासाद्य नरोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Uttanka, of great splendour and measureless spirit, came up to that best of men, foremost among masters of all weapons, and stopped him.

verses.text: उत्तङ्क उवाच

meaning.en: Uttanka said:

verses.text:
भवता रक्षणं कार्यं तत्तावत्कर्तुमर्हसि ।
निरुद्विग्ना वयं राजंस्त्वत्प्रसादाद्वसेमहि ॥

meaning.en: Your duty is protection; you ought to do that first. Free of anxiety, king, we can live by your grace.

verses.text:
त्वया हि पृथिवी राजन्रक्ष्यमाणा महात्मना ।
भविष्यति निरुद्विग्ना नारण्यं गन्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: For with the earth protected by you, great-souled king, it will be free of fear; you should not go to the forest.

verses.text:
पालने हि महान्धर्मः प्रजानामिह दृश्यते ।
न तथा दृश्यतेऽरण्ये मा ते भूद्बुद्धिरीदृशी ॥

meaning.en: In protecting subjects here a great dharma is seen; it is not seen so in the forest. Let no such thought be yours.

verses.text:
ईदृशो न हि राजेन्द्र धर्मः क्वचन दृश्यते ।
प्रजानां पालने यो वै पुरा राजर्षिभिः कृतः ।
रक्षितव्याः प्रजा राज्ञा तास्त्वं रक्षितुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Such a dharma as the protection of subjects, which royal sages did in the past, is seen nowhere else, king of kings. A king must protect his subjects, and you ought to protect them.

verses.text:
निरुद्विग्नस्तपश्चर्तुं न हि शक्नोमि पार्थिव ।
ममाश्रमसमीपे वै समेषु मरुधन्वसु ॥

meaning.en: Without being free of fear I cannot practise austerity, king. Near my hermitage, in the level desert country,

verses.text:
समुद्रो वालुकापूर्ण उज्जानक इति स्मृतः ।
बहुयोजनविस्तीर्णो बहुयोजनमायतः ॥

meaning.en: there is a sea full of sand called Ujjanaka, many leagues wide and many leagues long.

verses.text:
तत्र रौद्रो दानवेन्द्रो महावीर्यपराक्रमः ।
मधुकैटभयोः पुत्रो धुन्धुर्नाम सुदारुणः ॥

meaning.en: There lives a fierce lord of the danavas of great might and valour, the terrible Dhundhu, son of Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.text:
अन्तर्भूमिगतो राजन्वसत्यमितविक्रमः ।
तं निहत्य महाराज वनं त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: He dwells underground, king, of immeasurable prowess. Kill him, great king, and then you may go to the forest.

verses.text:
शेते लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम् ।
त्रिदशानां विनाशाय लोकानां चापि पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: He sleeps there, having taken up dreadful austerity, for the destruction of the worlds, king, and of the gods and the worlds as well.

verses.text:
अवध्यो देवतानां स दैत्यानामथ रक्षसाम् ।
नागानामथ यक्षाणां गन्धर्वाणां च सर्वशः ।
अवाप्य स वरं राजन्सर्वलोकपितामहात् ॥

meaning.en: He has received a boon from the grandfather of all worlds, king, that he cannot be killed by gods, daityas, rakshasas, serpents, yakshas or gandharvas in any way.

verses.text:
तं विनाशय भद्रं ते मा ते बुद्धिरतोऽन्यथा ।
प्राप्स्यसे महतीं कीर्तिं शाश्वतीमव्ययां ध्रुवाम् ॥

meaning.en: Destroy him; may you be well. Do not think otherwise. You will gain great, lasting, imperishable and steady fame.

verses.text:
क्रूरस्य स्वपतस्तस्य वालुकान्तर्हितस्य वै ।
संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते निःश्वासः संप्रवर्तते ।
यदा तदा भूश्चलति सशैलवनकानना ॥

meaning.en: When that cruel one sleeps hidden under the sand, at the end of a year his breath comes out, and at that time the earth shakes with its mountains, woods and forests.

verses.text:
तस्य निःश्वासवातेन रज उद्धूयते महत् ।
आदित्यपथमावृत्य सप्ताहं भूमिकम्पनम् ।
सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं सधूमं ह्यतिदारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: By the wind of his breath great dust is blown up, covering the sun's path, and for a week the earth quakes, with sparks, flames and smoke, most dreadful.

verses.text:
तेन राजन्न शक्नोमि तस्मिन्स्थातुं स्व आश्रमे ।
तं विनाशय राजेन्द्र लोकानां हितकाम्यया ।
लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्त्वद्य तस्मिन्विनिहतेऽसुरे ॥

meaning.en: Because of it, king, I cannot stay in my hermitage. Destroy him, king of kings, out of a wish for the good of the worlds; let the worlds be at ease today when that demon is slain.

verses.text:
त्वं हि तस्य विनाशाय पर्याप्त इति मे मतिः ।
तेजसा तव तेजश्च विष्णुराप्याययिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: I think you are able to destroy him, and Vishnu will add his power to yours.

verses.text:
विष्णुना च वरो दत्तो मम पूर्वं ततो वधे ।
यस्तं महासुरं रौद्रं वधिष्यति महीपतिः ।
तेजस्तं वैष्णवमिति प्रवेक्ष्यति दुरासदम् ॥

meaning.en: Vishnu gave me a boon of old concerning his death: the king who kills that great fierce demon will be entered by Vishnu's power, hard to resist.

verses.text:
तत्तेजस्त्वं समाधाय राजेन्द्र भुवि दुःसहम् ।
तं निषूदय संदुष्टं दैत्यं रौद्रपराक्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: Take up that power, king of kings, which is hard to bear on earth, and slay that evil daitya of fearful valour.

verses.text:
न हि धुन्धुर्महातेजास्तेजसाल्पेन शक्यते ।
निर्दग्धुं पृथिवीपाल स हि वर्षशतैरपि ॥

meaning.en: For the very powerful Dhundhu cannot be burned up by small power, protector of the earth, even in hundreds of years.
